journal_lines_party_check.name: journal_lines_party_check
journal_lines_party_check.value: ("journal_lines"."party_type" is null) = ("journal_lines"."party_id" is null) and ("journal_lines"."party_type" is null or "journal_lines"."party_type" in ('customer', 'supplier'))

expenses_void_check.name: expenses_void_check
expenses_void_check.value: "expenses"."status" <> 'voided' or ("expenses"."voided_at" is not null and "expenses"."void_reason" is not null)

payments_no_duplicate_ref.name: payments_no_duplicate_ref
payments_no_duplicate_ref.where: "payments"."reference" is not null and "payments"."status" = 'recorded' and "payments"."method" in ('upi', 'cheque', 'bank')

purchase_returns_refund_check.name: purchase_returns_refund_check
purchase_returns_refund_check.value: ("purchase_returns"."settlement" = 'refund') = ("purchase_returns"."refund_method" is not null and "purchase_returns"."refund_payment_id" is not null)

invoices_tax_mode_amounts_check.name: invoices_tax_mode_amounts_check
invoices_tax_mode_amounts_check.value: ("invoices"."tax_mode" = 'intra' and "invoices"."igst_paise" = 0) or ("invoices"."tax_mode" = 'inter' and "invoices"."cgst_paise" = 0 and "invoices"."sgst_paise" = 0) or ("invoices"."tax_mode" = 'none' and "invoices"."cgst_paise" = 0 and "invoices"."sgst_paise" = 0 and "invoices"."igst_paise" = 0)
